versions.changelog: Added macro/cryptocurrency templates, custom templates, config UI, insights generation, API integration, and security features
Added Alpha Vantage integration, heatmap/radar charts, PDF export, and interactive features
Added pricing tiers: Free (3 gens), Professional (.99/mo), Enterprise (9.99/mo)
Switched to browser-based rendering using OpenClaw's canvas tool. Removed node-canvas dependency.
Initial release: stock analysis, portfolio monitoring, industry comparison templates with financial-grade charts
